description: Adapted from docling (MIT) via the xberg test-document corpus (td/vendored/docling): a heading inside a table cell and the text after the table. Input html/files/table_with_heading_02.html (see ../README.txt). Tika 4.2.0 (oracle, /tika/text) writes a tab BEFORE each cell, not after: the assertion follows its output.

assertions.value: Main Title[\s\S]*Before the table[\s\S]*A\s+text[\s\S]*\tB[\s\S]*\t1\.\.\.[\s\S]*\t2\.\.\.[\s\S]*Section After[\s\S]*After the table
